content:
Ana (Head of Growth): Quick check before KPI review: benchmark launch boosted traffic but demo rate slid. Need attribution clarity and a dashboard slice we can show execs. https://dash.redwood.ai/marketing/weekly :mag:
Matt (Demand): Noticed. Paid push + benchmark post = lots of top-of-funnel but lower demo conversion. Are we double-counting assisted channels?
Rita (Analytics): Initial look: sessions +28%, leads +15%, demo_bookings unchanged. Last-click attributes most to paid; multi-touch credits partners and webinar more. Raw sample:
```
2026-03-28,paid,benchmark_push,450,22,8
2026-03-28,organic,benchmark_hub,320,14,3
2026-03-29,partners,bench-webinar,110,3,0
```
Rita (Analytics): Partner cohort has lower demo conversion. Also, routing rule moves partner leads to partner_flow so their downstream demos aren't showing in our inbound funnel.
Sam (Content): We ran a short CTA test on the hub (demo vs download) which may affect lead quality.
router-bot: rule-check: utm_source=partners -> pipeline:partner_flow (set 2026-02-12 by Ops)
Ana (Head of Growth): For the short term: mirror partner leads into inbound_test tag for 5 days so we can compare end-to-end without breaking partner SLAs. Also add a "CTA type" breakdown on the weekly tile.
Rita (Analytics): Will add two widgets: "Attribution compare (last-click/linear)" and "CTA quality by utm_campaign". ETA 3 hours. Will include CI notes and min-sample warning.
Matt (Demand): Can Ops schedule the mirror? We want to avoid changing live pipeline behavior.
router-bot: mirror-rule-scheduled: partner_mirror=true for utm_source=partners starting 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z for 5d (created by Ops)
Sam (Content): I'll revert the hub CTA to the demo variant for the next 48h to stabilize creative signal.
Ana (Head of Growth): Good. Action owners: Rita (widgets + export), Ops (mirror tag), Sam (CTA revert). We'll review in Friday KPI sync; if mirrored cohort shows similar demo conversion to inbound, we keep current routing; if not, revert CTA test and rethink co-promos. Drop anything odd here before Friday.
